title: Foundation
description: Outcome: an initial usable Docker/Compose CLI product with non-root defaults, persistent state, baseline security and accurate operating docs. Complete when clean build, default/optional runtime controls, state recreation, ARM64/Portainer compatibility and consented authentication acceptance have evidence; green CI alone is insufficient.

title: Access & Reliability
description: Outcome: recoverable state and a maintainable security posture. Complete when credential-safe encrypted backup/restore and migration drills, SSH least-privilege review, dependency reproducibility/provenance and supply-chain update procedures have reviewed evidence.

title: Developer Experience
description: Outcome: operators and contributors can diagnose, customize and use the environment safely. Complete when privacy-preserving diagnostics, optional toolchain/MCP recipes, reviewed documentation/wiki maintenance and remote-terminal client guidance meet their acceptance criteria.

title: Exploration
description: Outcome: explicit architectural and product decisions on future capabilities. Complete when assigned proposals have compatibility/security/maintenance assessments and recorded go/no-go decisions. No implementation, release or deployment is implied.
